subject.title: fix(wechat): preserve existing accounts across hot reload

question: For this WeChat-backed hot-reload change, must merge require redacted live A+B QR-login proof, or are the focused gateway lifecycle regressions and normal checks sufficient?
rationale: The remaining merge gate is an evidence threshold for real provider behavior, not a mechanical code repair; automated review cannot truthfully choose that acceptance standard.

options.title: Require live WeChat proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until someone with a real WeChat QR-login setup provides redacted evidence that adding account B leaves account A online after the reload handoff.

options.title: Accept gateway-level proof
options.body: Explicitly waive provider-session proof and merge only after the branch is rebased and the focused lifecycle checks pass on the exact merge head.

recommendation.title: Require live WeChat proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until someone with a real WeChat QR-login setup provides redacted evidence that adding account B leaves account A online after the reload handoff.

likelyOwner.reason: The recorded gateway-review routing signal makes this the best available owner candidate, although repository history could not be fully inspected in this read-only environment.
